mentions.name: DocuView
mentions.description: DocuView is a product for the real estate industry that the author launched full-time after quitting their job a year ago. It is deliberately opinionated, built around the features the team themselves wants rather than a broad all-in-one offering where users only use a fraction of the features.
mentions.problem: The author saw demand in real estate for this kind of product, contrasting it with existing offerings that try to fit everyone but whose users only use about 20% of the features.

mentions.name: DocuView
mentions.description: A disclosure editing, sharing, and reviewing platform for real estate professionals. It aims to serve as the central place where most of the transaction takes place, giving the entire party a single location for communication and transparency.
mentions.audience: A platform for real estate professionals and all parties to a transaction.
